title: “Welcome Home”
deck: A painted poster for a short film, in two versions.
lede: “Welcome Home” is a short film written and directed by Jo Rochelle. Its poster paints two people sitting on the grass, their backs to us, facing a white house under palm trees and a blue sky, in two versions.
challenge: “Welcome Home,” a short film written and directed by Jo Rochelle, needed a poster.
work: The poster is a painting: two people sit on the grass with their backs to us, facing a white house under palm trees and a blue sky, with the title above in tall yellow letters.
A second version sets the same painting inside a white border, with the title in black.
system: Two people facing a white house.
Full bleed, and inside a white border.
